content: {"phoneNote":"Hero headline and intro text run off the right edge of the 360px screen, and the dark CTA heading does the same.","desktopNote":"Hero is sound but the page below has dead bands: an empty gold strip closes the first screen, the 2006 number is enormous and the region text floats in a large empty grey area.","phone":{"impression":2,"hierarchy":2,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":2},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":2},"fixes":["Fix horizontal overflow on phone: size the hero headline and CTA heading to the viewport (break long words or scale down) and keep body text inside the 360px column.","Merge the three contact blocks (after 2006, Obiščite nas, footer) into one and turn the hero's two underlined text links into a single solid Pokličite button.","Tighten desktop rhythm: shrink the 2006 figure, align the region text with the top of the valley photo, and replace the generic tool stock photo with a shot of actual work (omarica, inštalacija)."],"blockers":["Phone hero: headline 'ELEKTROINŠTALACIJE' is clipped at the right edge of the screen.","Phone hero: intro paragraph overflows the viewport ('Pokličite nas,' cut off).","Phone dark CTA: heading '?' and 'Pridemo k' are cut off at the right edge.","Phone and desktop: phone number, address and 'Navodila za pot' repeat in three separate blocks (after 2006 section, Obiščite nas, footer)."]}
